summary: v52by Round-6 testing. Backend: all 7 pytest tests pass — Reverse Auction create defaults (#64), floor>=starting guard, BOQ xlsx+pdf exports with 401/404 handling (#48/#57), corrigenda withdraw endpoint reachable. Frontend: BOQ export buttons present with correct data-testid and both xlsx & pdf downloads trigger natively. CRITICAL finding: the admin Reverse Auctions screen that users actually see is rendered by /app/frontend/src/apps/admin-console-e/AdminAuctionsE.jsx — NOT LiveAuctionsPanel.jsx that the main agent edited. AdminAuctionsE uses data-testid='auction-start-<id>' (not 'ra-start-<id>' per task spec); Start button is correctly not client-disabled on <2 participants, and start() surfaces the backend's clear 'need at least 2 participants' message via showApiError toast. Corrigendum withdraw uses window.prompt() which blocks playwright scripting; optimistic local-state flip is implemented in code (CorrigendaPanel.jsx line 192-195) but could not be validated end-to-end from automation. Backend list visibility #59 works (new draft is first row after creation). #60 Start-does-nothing was already fixed via `disabled={busyId===a.id}` only.

ui_bugs.issue: data-testid is `auction-start-<id>` not the spec-mandated `ra-start-<id>`. Main agent updated LiveAuctionsPanel.jsx but that panel is NOT mounted on /admin/e/auctions — AdminAuctionsE.jsx is. Any downstream automation / QA scripts keyed to `ra-start-<id>` will fail against the live app.

integration_issues.issue: Uses window.prompt() (native blocking dialog) for the 10+ character reason. Cannot be reliably automated with playwright without a page.on('dialog') handler, and more importantly it is a jarring UX versus a shadcn modal with a textarea & character-counter. The optimistic local state flip itself IS in the code (CorrigendaPanel.jsx L192-195: setItems((prev) => prev.map(c => c.id === cid ? {...c, is_active:false, ...} : c))) so from code review the fix is correct — but still bound behind window.prompt().

action_items: AdminAuctionsE.jsx line 350: either (a) rename data-testid to `ra-start-${a.id}` to match the Round-6 spec OR (b) update the Round-6 bug tracker to pin the official testid as `auction-start-<id>`. Please decide one and apply consistently to any sibling testids (`auction-close-<id>`, `auction-invite-toggle-<id>`, `auction-open-<id>` etc).

LiveAuctionsPanel.jsx is dead code — not routed anywhere in AdminDashboard tabs that the AdminShell sidebar surfaces. Either remove the file or confirm it's used by a non-admin surface. Right now main agent is editing LiveAuctionsPanel.jsx for Round-6 fixes but the user is seeing AdminAuctionsE.jsx — all three Round-6 UI fixes targeting Reverse Auctions were applied to the wrong file.

CorrigendaPanel.jsx: replace window.prompt() for withdraw reason with a shadcn Dialog containing a <textarea data-testid='corr-withdraw-reason-input'> and a confirm button `data-testid='corr-withdraw-confirm-${id}'`. This unblocks the Round-6 automated verification of optimistic refresh (#49).
Consider adding a thin re-export shim so Round-6 `ra-start-<id>` is honoured until the testid rename lands.
critical_code_review_comments: There are TWO panels that both appear to list reverse auctions (LiveAuctionsPanel.jsx + admin-console-e/AdminAuctionsE.jsx). Only one is routed. Dead code like this is exactly what caused the main agent to spend fix budget on the wrong file. Delete LiveAuctionsPanel.jsx or move it under a /legacy/ folder.

Backend ReverseAuctionIn now gives default values (floor_price=0.0, min_decrement=1.0), but there is NO sanity check that min_decrement <= starting_price — a draft created with starting=5, min_decrement=1000 will pass validation and later be unusable. Low priority but easy win.
boqs.py export.pdf uses weasyprint which can be slow/blocking in async handler — consider offloading to a threadpool executor for templates with >100 items.

boqs.py export filename uses `doc.get('name','').replace(' ', '-')` directly — doesn't sanitise quotes or newlines; a BOQ template named `My\"BOQ` would produce a malformed Content-Disposition. Use a stricter slug function.
